assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A circle of radius 2 with centre O2; the dashed circle of radius 1 with centre O1 sits on top of it, tangent at X, with a blue line through O1 and a point P. After rolling clockwise through 60 degrees about O2 (angle marked), the solid small circle has centre O1' and touches the large circle at Y; the blue line through O1' and the moved point P' is parallel to the first one. The red chord XY has length 2.

difficulty_rationale: Requires seeing that the rolling circle turns through three times the angle of its centre (not twice), and that a parallel line already occurs after a half turn.
